author: sam ausloos
text: Great communication and fast service. Walked me through how to check things on the phone to make sure I actually needed them to come out. Would recommend to anyone that needs septic service in the Chippewa valley.

author: L. Newton
text: Outstanding service! Plus, I had a couple of questions about things I needed to do - got great advice and links to products I could get for myself.

author: Jody Dallas
text: I knew I made this right call as soon as I dialed the number.  Travis called back promptly and we were on the schedule right away.  His knowledge and recommendations were second to none.  Travis cleaned our filter, which doesn’t always happen.  He was attentive to his work the whole time.  We will continue to have him maintain our system!

author: Jerome Malecki
text: Came and pumped us out today, very professional and informative. Explain everything he was doing and why. They also take care of paperwork for the county. Definitely recommend Chippewa septic service.

author: T-BO Studio
text: We have used Chippewa Septic for Tank Pumping and Cleaning for over 45 years both at our Business and our Home. When you call Travis, you get a Professional and Responsible Person who cares about your needs. You can count on his scheduling and the quality of the work done. As you can say when you need your Sepic taken care of... "Who do you call, Chippewa Septic".
